title: v4.8.4 -`user_agent_types` validator rejects `BRAVE` returned by ZIA API

blocks.heading: v4.8.4 -`user_agent_types` validator rejects `BRAVE` returned by ZIA API

blocks.code:
resource "zia_url_filtering_rules" "example" {
  name             = "Example Rule"
  state            = "ENABLED"
  action           = "ALLOW"
  user_agent_types = ["OPERA", "FIREFOX", "MSIE", "MSEDGE", "CHROME", "SAFARI", "MSCHREDGE", "OTHER"]
  # BRAVE cannot be added here — provider validator rejects it at plan time
}

blocks.text: `BRAVE` should be a valid value for `user_agent_types`. The ZIA API already returns it for existing rules, so the provider schema and validator should accept it. Users should be able to include `"BRAVE"` in their HCL configuration without a validation error.
`terraform plan` fails with a validation error when the ZIA API returns `BRAVE` as part of `user_agent_types` during state refresh:

blocks.code: expected [{pathStepImpl:{} Name:user_agent_types} {pathStepImpl:{} Key:{ty:{typeImpl:{typeImplSigil:{} Kind:78}} v:0xc000aeee70}}] to be one of ["OPERA" "FIREFOX" "MSIE" "MSEDGE" "CHROME" "SAFARI" "MSCHREDGE" "OTHER"], got BRAVE

blocks.text: This is a read-time failure - it occurs during `terraform plan` when the provider reads existing rules back from the ZIA API and the API response contains `BRAVE`. There is no workaround within Terraform since adding `"BRAVE"` to the HCL also fails the same validator.

blocks.item: Have an existing `zia_url_filtering_rules` resource with a broad `user_agent_types`

blocks.text: selection already imported into Terraform state

blocks.item: Terraform refreshes state by calling the ZIA API for that rule
The provider validator rejects it - plan fails
The affected rules were **not manually edited** in the ZIA portal - audit logs confirm

blocks.text: no GUI changes were made to these rules

blocks.item: Only rules with broad/catch-all browser selections appear to be affected. Zscaler's

blocks.text: backend appears to have retroactively added `BRAVE` to rules that had wide browser coverage, likely as part of a backend update adding Brave browser support

blocks.item: The root cause is in `zia/validator.go` - `supportedUserAgentTypes` does not include

blocks.text: Suggested fix: add `"BRAVE"` to this slice. Also consider updating the ISOLATE action validation message in `resource_zia_url_filtering_rules.go` if Brave is valid for ISOLATE rules.
@(user) Issue has been resolved in the latest version v4.8.9. Please upgrade.
